Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Thin controller layer that mediates between the network layer (via Socket or RMI) and the game model. It receives client actions (join, place totem, take card), delegates them to the ModelInterface, and returns the resulting deltas or other response objects.
